prompt.objective: Create an original photographic editorial for the lower product page of IQON Retinol Rx. Use the reference solely as the exact packaging authority. This must feel like an expensive real studio photograph, not a computer render.
prompt.scene: A single exact reference bottle lies diagonally on a smooth charcoal-grey satin-metal surface, cap towards upper right, base lower left. Tight considered macro composition: bottle occupies about 72% of image height with all edges intact. A single oblique band of cool late-evening window light traces the polished silver cap and a long soft shadow. Deep gray tonal backdrop, gently lighter at upper left. No props.
prompt.packaging: Preserve the original upright serif IQON logo, white paper label, slim silver cylinder and long silver cap, dimensions and all original label wording: IQON / SKINCARE / Retinol Rx / 1 fl oz (30 ml). Keep label facing the camera readable with plausible cylindrical curvature.
prompt.photography: 90mm macro commercial product lens, realistic focus falloff but full label sharp. Real brushed metal microtexture, slightly imperfect highlight falloff, very fine paper texture, controlled cool highlights with genuine light reflections. Silver not chrome CGI. Understated luxury.
